atoms.exact_source_text: A governed extraction of the v0.4.7 decisions that remain useful after the v0.5 Home and Away redesigns.
atoms.normalized_claim: The document is a governed extraction of the v0.4.7 decisions that remain useful after the v0.5 Home and Away redesigns.

atoms.exact_source_text: The document preserves MEDIAN’s attention architecture, shared world-state doctrine, MEET authoring rules, and presentation safeguards while explicitly retiring incompatible 0.4.7 assumptions.
atoms.normalized_claim: The document preserves MEDIAN's attention architecture, shared world-state doctrine, MEET authoring rules, and presentation safeguards while explicitly retiring incompatible 0.4.7 assumptions.

atoms.exact_source_text: v0.4.7 Running Decisions
atoms.normalized_claim: The source basis includes v0.4.7 Running Decisions.

atoms.exact_source_text: v0.5 Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification
atoms.normalized_claim: The source basis includes the v0.5 Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification.

atoms.exact_source_text: v0.5 Away Loop Rework
atoms.normalized_claim: The source basis includes the v0.5 Away Loop Rework.

atoms.exact_source_text: v0.5 Philosophical Specification
atoms.normalized_claim: The source basis includes the v0.5 Philosophical Specification.

atoms.exact_source_text: Working specification for the structured v0.5 revision document
atoms.normalized_claim: The status of this document is a working specification for the structured v0.5 revision document.

atoms.exact_source_text: When this document conflicts with a v0.5 system specification, the newer v0.5 specification leads
atoms.normalized_claim: When this document conflicts with a v0.5 system specification, the newer v0.5 specification leads.

atoms.exact_source_text: Guest Citizen mechanics and species-specific Guest capability design are deferred to a dedicated v0.5 pass
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest Citizen mechanics and species-specific Guest capability design are deferred to a dedicated v0.5 pass.

atoms.exact_source_text: “v0.4.7 Cross-System Carryforward” is the working name for the cross-system rulings first developed in the v0.4.7 Registers, Views, and Encounter Mode thread and retained after the v0.5 redesign.
atoms.normalized_claim: "v0.4.7 Cross-System Carryforward" is the working name for the cross-system rulings first developed in the v0.4.7 Registers, Views, and Encounter Mode thread and retained after the v0.5 redesign.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is not a revival of v0.4.7 as active canon.
atoms.normalized_claim: The v0.4.7 Cross-System Carryforward is not a revival of v0.4.7 as active canon.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is a controlled salvage operation: keep the architectural decisions that make the new Home and Away specifications cohere
atoms.normalized_claim: The v0.4.7 Cross-System Carryforward is a controlled salvage operation that keeps the architectural decisions that make the new Home and Away specifications cohere.

atoms.exact_source_text: archive the assumptions those specifications have superseded.
atoms.normalized_claim: The controlled salvage operation archives the assumptions those specifications have superseded.

atoms.exact_source_text: The original log was explicitly proposed rather than settled canon.
atoms.normalized_claim: The original log was explicitly proposed rather than settled canon.

atoms.exact_source_text: This specification therefore does not preserve entries because they were marked SETTLED inside that log.
atoms.normalized_claim: This specification does not preserve entries because they were marked SETTLED inside the original log.

atoms.exact_source_text: It re-rules them against the v0.5 architecture.
atoms.normalized_claim: This specification re-rules the original log's entries against the v0.5 architecture.

atoms.exact_source_text: | 1            | v0.5 Philosophical Specification       | Defines the game’s governing thesis, Home/Away split, attachment-first base-building purpose, and five-Register architecture. |
atoms.normalized_claim: At precedence priority 1, the v0.5 Philosophical Specification defines the game's governing thesis, Home/Away split, attachment-first base-building purpose, and five-Register architecture.

atoms.exact_source_text: | 2            | v0.5 Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification                  | Leads all domestic economy, Readiness, Role, Place, Project, Home MEET, Quiet Equilibrium, and EMBODY questions.              |
atoms.normalized_claim: At precedence priority 2, the v0.5 Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification leads all domestic economy, Readiness, Role, Place, Project, Home MEET, Quiet Equilibrium, and EMBODY questions.

atoms.exact_source_text: | 3            | v0.5 Away Loop Rework                  | Leads Launch, Crossing, Field, Nodes, Away MEET, Exposure, Return, Stopover, and Homecoming questions.                        |
atoms.normalized_claim: At precedence priority 3, the v0.5 Away Loop Rework leads Launch, Crossing, Field, Nodes, Away MEET, Exposure, Return, Stopover, and Homecoming questions.

atoms.exact_source_text: | 4            | Other dedicated v0.5 specifications    | Lead within their subjects, including Embodiment, Ecology, Manifestations, and future Guest Citizen work.                     |
atoms.normalized_claim: At precedence priority 4, other dedicated v0.5 specifications lead within their subjects, including Embodiment, Ecology, Manifestations, and future Guest Citizen work.

atoms.exact_source_text: | 5            | This v0.4.7 Cross-System Attention, Persistence, and World-State Carryforward | Provides shared attention, authoring, display, persistence, and world-state doctrine across the above systems.                |
atoms.normalized_claim: At precedence priority 5, this v0.4.7 Cross-System Attention, Persistence, and World-State Carryforward provides shared attention, authoring, display, persistence, and world-state doctrine across the above systems.

atoms.exact_source_text: | 6            | The v0.4.7 Running Decisions log       | Historical source and rationale only.                                                                                         |
atoms.normalized_claim: At precedence priority 6, the v0.4.7 Running Decisions log serves as historical source and rationale only.

atoms.exact_source_text: No 0.4.7 rule survives merely by silence.
atoms.normalized_claim: No 0.4.7 rule survives merely by silence.

atoms.exact_source_text: Contradictory assumptions are named as superseded rather than quietly inherited.
atoms.normalized_claim: Contradictory assumptions are named as superseded rather than quietly inherited.

atoms.exact_source_text: The v0.5 redesign gives MEDIAN two highly developed halves: DWELL makes sanctuary mechanically achievable at Colony scale, while TRAVEL / RISK / MEET expose particular Citizens to distance and consequence.
atoms.normalized_claim: The v0.5 redesign gives MEDIAN two highly developed halves: DWELL makes sanctuary mechanically achievable at Colony scale, while TRAVEL / RISK / MEET expose particular Citizens to distance and consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: The v0.4.7 Cross-System Carryforward decisions provide the connective tissue that makes those halves feel like one game.
atoms.normalized_claim: The v0.4.7 Cross-System Carryforward decisions provide the connective tissue that makes DWELL and TRAVEL/RISK/MEET feel like one game.

atoms.exact_source_text: When continuous Register play remains continuous and when the game fixes attention through MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: This specification governs when continuous Register play remains continuous and when the game fixes attention through MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: How one authored situation can manifest differently in Home and Away contexts without becoming two systems.
atoms.normalized_claim: This specification governs how one authored situation can manifest differently in Home and Away contexts without becoming two systems.
